message:
Have you ever had that moment when your phone dies just when you need it the most? We once found ourselves on a family hike, enjoying nature, when suddenly our navigation app decided it was time to take a nap. 😅 Thankfully, we had a trusty paper map tucked away in our backpack, and after a little laughter and some team effort, we found our way back safely. 

This little adventure reminded us how important it is to have backup plans — whether it’s a power bank for our devices or a good old-fashioned map. We love hearing how others stay prepared, so what’s your go-to tip for tech hiccups?
